caption: The drawing depicts the front façade of a building with a central arched doorway flanked by two rectangular sections made up of brickwork, each section topped with a capital. Above the doorway is a smooth, triangular gable roof with a framed square window in the center and a small opening above it, both positioned symmetrically. At the top of the gable, there is a small rectangular element with a cross on top. The entire structure is rendered in black and white, with varied shading to indicate texture, particularly in the brickwork and the sloped roof surface. Below the image, there are two ribbon-like banners; the upper banner contains the number "1782" and the lower banner contains the handwritten words "mision san buenaventura" along with "F. Jones" on the right edge of the banner. The background is left blank, placing emphasis solely on the building and the text.
title: Mision San Buenaventura
